limitations: No matched normal or panel of normals: primer-efficiency, GC and capture bias are uncorrected, so a 'gain' may be a technical artefact.
Tumour purity and ploidy are unknown; log2 ratios cannot be converted to absolute copy number.
Genes with few targets give noisy estimates; interpret only large, consistent shifts.
For a defensible CNV call use CNVkit with a pooled reference of >= 10-20 samples processed identically (Talevich et al. 2016).
